audit.report: A batch replayable inventory job (pid 89908) held an idle transaction for 4.1 seconds, blocking 12 sessions and degrading checkout success to 58% over 30 seconds with $7,667/min revenue at risk. The Database Guardian initially proposed waiting but switched to termination after trade-off analysis showed waiting would cost ~$114,476 in lost revenue and exceed the 60-second degradation tolerance, while termination only required a 4-minute replay of the idempotent job. The Continuity Guardian accepted the termination proposal, and the authority authorized it after deterministic checks passed. The executor terminated the batch worker, and verification confirmed full recovery: zero lock waits, 100% checkout success over 10 seconds, and no protected settlements aborted. Total incident duration was 46.6 seconds with one negotiation round.
audit.root_cause: A batch_replayable_inventory worker (pid 89908) held an idle-in-transaction state for 4.1 seconds, blocking checkout sessions and causing SLO breach.
lessons: For batch_replayable_inventory: add a pre-flight check for idle-in-transaction duration >2s to trigger automatic termination, since the job is idempotent, replayable in 4 minutes, and has policy 'may_interrupt'.
For batch_replayable_inventory: instrument the job to emit heartbeat metrics (last_checkpoint_age, txn_idle_seconds) so guardians can quantify staleness without probing pg_stat_activity.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian efficiently pivoted from wait to terminate within the same round after gathering workload registry, protected settlements, change calendar, and impact evidence, avoiding a second round. No guardian wasted rounds or missed critical evidence; the trade-off calculator (BIZ-5) provided the decisive quantitative basis for the switch.
follow_ups: Add idle-in-transaction alerting for batch_worker role with 2s threshold to catch stalls before they breach the 60s checkout degradation budget.
Document the 4-minute replay cost and 'may_interrupt' policy in the inventory_reconcile runbook so future guardians can decide without probing biz.workload_registry.
Verify that statement_timeout=5s is applied to all batch_worker connections in the connection pooler config.
